definitions.explanation: Describes treating someone with careful politeness and respect, especially in formal situations. Implies a deliberate, attentive manner of showing respect. Often used to describe the way someone declines, greets, or treats guests.

examples.japanese: {丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{迎|むか}え→お迎え：27645_omukae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We welcome guests with the utmost courtesy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丁重|ていちょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧し、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{静|しず}めた→静める：19446_shizumeru⟧。
examples.english: He apologized in a courteous manner and calmed the other person's anger.

notes:
USAGE:
{丁重|ていちょう} is a na-adjective. It is used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (politely refuse). It conveys a formal, deliberate kind of politeness — more ceremonious than everyday courtesy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (politely decline)
- {丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{迎|むか}え→お迎え：27645_omukae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (welcome courteously)
- {丁重|ていちょう}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧ (respectful treatment)
- {丁重|ていちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧ (entertain with hospitality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧ means "polite" or "careful" and is used in broader everyday contexts. {丁重|ていちょう} is more formal and implies a grander, more ceremonious level of respect. ⟦{慇懃|いんぎん}→慇懃：09465_ingin⟧ means "excessively polite" and can sometimes imply insincerity ({慇懃無礼|いんぎんぶれい}).
